_comment: Shared corpus for #3031: every locator must pick the element carrying data-expect-root (or none). Read by python/tests/test_root_selection_3031.py and crates/djust_live (dj_root_selection_3031).

cases.why: html5ever (and a browser) read this element's content as text; the Python mask and the text scanner only mask script/style/comments, so they see the lookalike (predates #3031)

cases.name: lookalike_in_title
cases.why: html5ever (and a browser) read this element's content as text; the Python mask and the text scanner only mask script/style/comments, so they see the lookalike (predates #3031)

cases.why: template content is a separate fragment in html5ever; Python and the scanner read it as markup (predates #3031)

cases.why: html5ever (and a browser) read this element's content as text; the Python mask and the text scanner only mask script/style/comments, so they see the lookalike (predates #3031)

cases.name: svg_element_as_root
cases.why: foreign-content elements can carry the root attribute

cases.name: svg_dj_root_beats_enclosing_dj_view
cases.why: dj-root anywhere beats dj-view, SVG included

cases.name: void_wrapper_after_the_root
cases.why: a void element carrying both attributes after the root: the root is already chosen

cases.name: void_wrapper_before_the_root
cases.why: a void element has no content: the VDOM reads it as a leaf, Python and the scanner treat it as an unclosed wrapper that claims the rest of the page. live_render never emits one (predates #3031 in kind: an unclosed wrapper claims the rest)

cases.name: self_closing_div_wrapper
cases.why: a self-closing flag on a div is ignored by HTML: the wrapper stays open and holds the rest, so there is no root on every side

cases.name: no_root_single_element
cases.why: plain fragment

cases.why: #3302: several top-level elements, no root

cases.name: body_dj_root
cases.why: #3302: a root on <body> is not a root

cases.name: head_dj_view
cases.why: a root on <head> is not a root

cases.name: html_root_with_inner_root
cases.why: an inner dj-root is still found under a document-element dj-view

cases.why: nothing at all

cases.why: tokenizer error recovery (#3054)
